text: Kaffee und Kuchen in the afternoon is a long tradition, and many cafés serve cake by the slice. At lunchtime, many places offer a Tagesgericht or Mittagstisch, a fixed cheaper menu of the day.

University canteens (Mensa) offer a daily choice at student prices. Staff, guests and members of the public can often eat there too, usually at a slightly higher price. Pay with a canteen card or cash.
